title.zh: 【英国高院裁定钱志敏案 6.1 万枚比特币追索适用中国法律，受害者或无缘巨额增值收益】
title.en: 【英国高院裁定钱志敏案 6.1 万枚比特币追索适用中国法律，受害者或无缘巨额增值收益】

current_state.zh: The UK High Court ruled that Chinese investors' claims to over 61,000 bitcoins tied to the Lantian Gerui fraud case must be governed by Chinese law, meaning roughly 16,000 victims may recover only principal and interest rather than the bitcoin's large price gains.
